summary: Postback shard rewrite caused reclassification of hourly credits across cost centers
description:
Issue summary:
Customer QuillHealth reported unexpected redistribution of provisional hourly credits across multiple cost centers after we deployed a postback shard rewrite on 2026-03-09. They observed credits that were previously attributed to a reserved-dedicated cost center drop from the expected buffer and reappear under a legacy cost center ID.

Impact:
- Invoice preview shows ~€4,120 reallocated from reserved-dedicated buffer to legacy cost center for the period 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-09.
- Customer reports accounting reconciliation failed for month-end forecast. No functional degradation of inference; purely metering/billing impact.

Environment:
- Prod (eu-west)
- Tenant: quillhealth-prod (enterprise account, VPC private deployment fallback to hosted)
- Affected model: redwood/open-4k-v1 (batch embedding and streaming chat mix)

Steps to reproduce observed behavior (customer perspective):
1) Run hourly batch embed jobs from 2026-03-08 22:00 CET - 2026-03-09 03:00 CET.
2) View invoice preview in Console > Billing > Usage.
3) Filter by cost center tag "reserved-dedicated-quill" and observe missing provisional buffer credits.
4) Query raw postback events from our ingestion (they provided sample postback IDs).

Expected behavior:
- Hourly provisional buffer credits should apply to the cost center tagged in the postback (reserved-dedicated-quill).

Actual behavior:
- A subset of events were re-tagged to legacy cost center id "qh-legacy-2020" resulting in provisional credits being applied to the wrong ledger.

Logs / attachments provided by customer:
- invoice_preview_2026-03-09.csv (attached)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:18 - Maya Patel (Support): Acknowledged receipt. I've escalated to Billing and Reconciler teams and requested first-response by EOD. Provided customer with temporary manual ledger report export.
2026-03-10 11:02 - Ethan Liu (Billing): Investigating. Pulled postback samples from IDs provided by customer; records show cost_center tag mismatch on ingestion. Opening postback-reconciler trace.

2026-03-10 14:50 - Priya Rao (Postback Team): Found that the shard-rewrite migration (deployed 2026-03-09 02:20 UTC) included a legacy tag-mapping table entry that contains an overlapping prefix rule. This caused tags matching "qh-" to be rewritten to the legacy id for ~2 hours during the migration window. Patch candidate created.

2026-03-11 08:33 - Ethan Liu (Billing): Applied hotfix to postback-reconciler to skip legacy prefix mapping for known enterprise cost center namespaces. Reprocessed affected postback batch; provisional credits recalculated into correct ledger. We created a provisional invoice adjustment on the account.
2026-03-11 10:12 - QuillHealth Finance (Customer): Thanks — we see provisional credits reflected in Console but want confirmation that finalized invoice will not include the misapplied line items.

2026-03-14 15:01 - Maya Patel (Support): Confirming resolution: reprocessing completed, provisional adjustments applied, and billing team created a waiver to remove the legacy-line-item from the finalized invoice if it propagates. Closing after follow-up confirmation with finance team.
investigation:
Timeline of investigation:
- 2026-03-10: Reproducer and raw postback inspection show a cluster of events with postback.source_tag values containing 'qh-' being rewritten during the shard mapping pass.
- Tracing the deploy logs for postback-reconciler (deploy 2026-03-09 02:20 UTC) revealed a migration script that applied a deterministic prefix rewrite to support a previous tag normalization project.
- Hypothesis: a broad prefix rule ('qh-') was inadvertently added to the migration table and matched enterprise namespaces.
- Confirmed by looking at reconciler debug traces: events in the 02:15-04:40 UTC window went through the rewrite branch and were mutated before ledger attribution.
- Reprocessing plan: 1) stop automated rewriting, 2) re-ingest raw postbacks from S3 archive for affected time window, 3) recalculate provisional credits and update ledger.
- Actions taken: rollback of prefix rule at 2026-03-10 11:40 UTC; reprocess job executed 2026-03-11 03:00 UTC; QA spot checks against customer-provided IDs passed.
resolution:
Root cause: overly-permissive prefix rewrite rule in postback-reconciler migration table matched enterprise cost center prefixes (e.g., 'qh-') during shard-rewrite deploy 2026-03-09.
Fix applied:
- Reverted the migration rewrite rule and deployed patch to postback-reconciler (PR #389).
- Reprocessed archived postback events for 2026-03-08 21:00 UTC -> 2026-03-09 06:00 UTC and recalculated provisional credits.
- Created a provisional invoice adjustment and a waiver to prevent the legacy line item from reaching the finalized invoice. Manual ledger export shared with customer.
Follow-up actions:
1) Add an automated canary test for tag-mapping changes to run against a sample of enterprise cost centers prior to deploy. (Task created in INT-42901).
2) Add a pre-deploy validation that prevents prefix rules shorter than 5 characters from being accepted into the migration table.
3) Send formal postmortem to QuillHealth finance and internal billing teams (target 2026-03-20).
Customer impact mitigation:
- Applied a credit of €4,120 to the affected reserved-dedicated cost center as a temporary measure while reprocessing completed.
- Confirmed with customer that their month-end forecast aligns with post-reprocess numbers.
Status: Resolved (credits reapplied and waiver in place).
